column2: WARNING Breaker Shutter Linkage Sign – Spring Loaded Shutters Can Snap – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Spring Loaded Shutters Can Snap. This WARNING Breaker Shutter Linkage sign from CGAP Safety reads: BREAKER SHUTTER LINKAGE / SPRING LOADED SHUTTERS CAN SNAP / SECURE SHUTTER MECHANISM / BEFORE DISCONNECTING LINK RODS. Written for Electric utility substations, power generation plants, industrial switchgear rooms.

Why this sign matters

The shutter springs stay loaded while the link rods are connected. Disconnecting a rod without securing the mechanism lets the shutter snap and catch fingers or hands.

Where to post it

Mount on the front of the switchgear cell door frame beside the shutter linkage access cover.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance technician, relay and switchgear crew lead.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.147; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

Place the sign on the safety fence panel beside the tire barrier stack being taken down, at eye level for the crew.

Track safety crews, facility maintenance supervisors and safety officers.

The hot ironer chest is held up by its support mechanism. Servicing the support without blocking the chest lets it lower onto the technician's hands, crushing and burning them.

Laundry supervisors, facility maintenance leads and safety officers.
